Hi Alexa —

Thanks again for agreeing to the joint demo next week. Quick coordination note: the SI (HelixSI) asked to join the opening 20 minutes for architecture context, then Redwood will run the product walkthrough and AWS will close with procurement next steps. To make sure we have contingency, can you confirm the preferred window from these options?

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Option A: Tue 2027-07-20 09:00–10:00
- Option B: Tue 2027-07-20 13:00–14:00
- Option C: Wed 2027-07-21 11:00–12:00

If none of those work we can offer Thu morning. Please also confirm whether Rajesh (HelixSI) should get the full invite or only the first 30 minutes.

I've attached a lightweight runbook and HelixSI checklist for ops handoff. If Option B works we can lock the calendar and share a brief run-of-show (10 min pre-call sync for hosts).

Agenda (draft):
- 00:00–00:05: Introductions + outcomes
- 00:05–00:25: HelixSI architecture/context (Rajesh)
- 00:25–00:45: Redwood demo (Sofia)
- 00:45–00:55: Q&A + integration notes (all)
- 00:55–01:00: Procurement/next steps (AWS contacts)

Thanks — would appreciate a quick note with your preferred slot.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com

Attachments: clockwork-runbook-v1.pdf (runbook), helixsi-ops-checklist.xlsx (SI preflight)

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the clear options and the runbook. Option A looks tight for some of our east-coast execs; Option B would be preferable from our side. One ask: Rajesh flagged that he has a regional customer call at 13:15 PDT but can drop at 13:25. Could we shave 10 minutes from the middle segment (HelixSI to 15 minutes) so Rajesh still presents the architecture and then hops off? Alternatively, if you prefer to keep the original cadence we can push to Option C.

Also, two quick asks:
- Can you add a note in the invite saying "HelixSI will present 09:05–09:20" (we'll update the time slots once locked).
- We need the test dataset anonymization confirmation from Redwood (one-liner) for our security team — they asked to see that on the invite or linked doc.

If you confirm Option B with the shortened HelixSI window, I’ll ask our AWS partner contact (partners-ops@aws-partners.amazon.com) to join the final 10 minutes for procurement context.

Thanks,
Alexa

alexa@clockwork.ai
